newsitem.title: USA: US cash crudes finish session lower, grades drift.
newsitem.headline: US cash crudes finish session lower, grades drift.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes slid lower Thursday on pressure from NYMEX gasoline futures selling, while grade differentials deflated further to the close.
Talk that European gasoline cargoes were headed to the New York Harbor pushed crude outrights lower in the second-half of the day, ending a less-than-spirited bid for higher prices seen at midday.
Grade values were consistently weaker, squeezed by ample supplies of crude from both foreign and domestic sources.
February West Texas Intermediate/Cushing ended 30 cents lower at $26.25-35 a barrel, with Feb/Mar WTI at 65-70 cts.
